title: Touhou Tenryuuguu ~ Heavenly Gathering of Clouds - Romantic Tour ・ Dan-no-Ura
description:
The "Extra stage" theme from the game-without-a-game, Touhou-style music album, Heavenly Gathering of Clouds.

It's a suspenseful but energetic song, and one that keeps getting more excited as it goes along. It's probably good for fast, night stages. I just imagine a dark purple, for some reason.
